:::: {.about-intro}
I am a junior lecturer in the [Internet Engineering Technology (Teknologi Rekayasa Internet, TRI)](https://tri.sv.ugm.ac.id/) program at Universitas Gadjah Mada, Yogyakarta. My research focuses on **deep learning for computer vision and time series classification**, with work on eye tracking and medical image analysis.
